blocks.text: Pie chart aik gol (circular) graph hai jo sectors (qaashon, slices) mein bata hota hai; har sector poore data ka aik hissa (proportion) dikhata hai. Poora daira 100% (ya 360°) ke barabar hai, aur har sector ka zawiya (angle) us qisam ke hisse ke barabar nisbat mein hota hai. Pie charts categorical data ko 'poore ke hisson' ki shakal mein dikhane ke liye behtareen hain; is se biology mein mukhtalif groups ka hissa aasani se mila kar dekha ja sakta hai, jaise cells ki qismein, species ki taqseem, ya survey ke jawab.
Pie chart banane ke qadam (misaal)
Biology ki class ne 100 talaba (students) ke blood types ka survey kiya. Nataij yeh hain:

blocks.caption: Talaba ke blood types ka survey (kitab ka table)

blocks.text: Qadam 1: data tarteeb dein. Categorical data ko table mein rakhein aur har qisam ki frequency (ya total) likhein, jaisa oopar table mein hai.
Qadam 2: tamam frequencies jama kar ke total nikalein: talaba ki kul tadaad = 30 + 20 + 10 + 40 = 100.

blocks.caption: Har blood type ka sector angle

blocks.text: Qadam 3: sector angles nikalein: sector angle = (qisam ki qeemat / kul qeemat) × 360°.

Kitab ne qadam 3 ka formula 'Category value/ total value X 100' likha hai aur har zawiye ke saath '%' laga diya hai (108° %). Sector angle ke liye 360° se zarb dete hain (100 se zarb karne par feesad milta hai, zawiya nahi), aur jawab darjon (degrees) mein hai: 108°, 72°, 36°, 144°; in ka jama 360° hai. Kitab ke table mein zawiye sahih hain.
blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti

blocks.text: Qadam 4: pie chart banayein. Protractor (zawiya naapne ka aala) se daira bana kar, qadam 3 ke zawiye baari baari (clockwise ya anticlockwise) lagayein. Aik reference line (radius) se shuru karein, aur har qisam ke liye alag rang ya shade istemal karein.
Qadam 5: label aur title. Har sector par saaf label likhein, zaroorat ho to legend dein, aur chart ka wazeh title likhein.

blocks.alt: Pie chart: Distribution of blood types among students. Oopar se ghari ki sui ki simt (clockwise): A neela, 30%, 30; B narangi, 20%, 20; AB surmai, 10%, 10; O peela, 40%, 40. Neeche A, B, AB aur O ka legend.
blocks.caption: Talaba mein blood types ki taqseem ka pie chart (kitab ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: X-axis data figure

X-axis Cartesian coordinate system (do lakeeron wala graph) ya kisi data figure, jaise graph, chart ya plot, ki ufqi (horizontal) lakeer hai. Is par aam taur par independent variable (jo hum khud badalte hain) dikhaya jata hai. X-axis woh bunyadi lakeer (baseline) hai jis ke muqable mein doosre variables (aam taur par y-axis par) naape jate hain. Yeh hamesha baayen se daayen ufqi banti hai, aksar origin (0, 0) se shuru ho kar musbat (positive) taraf jati hai, lekin zaroorat ho to manfi (negative) qeematein bhi rakh sakti hai. Biology mein x-axis par aksar waqt ke waqfe, mukhtalif species ya experiment ke halaat dikhaye jate hain. Yeh muqable ki bunyad deti hai aur variables ke darmiyan rujhan (trend) ya taalluq dikhati hai.
X-axis data figure banane ke qadam (misaal)
Farz karein hum aik enzyme ki activity naap rahe hain, 5°C, 10°C, 20°C, 30°C aur 40°C par.

items: Qadam 1: variables pehchanein. Independent variable (x-axis): temperature (°C). Dependent variable (y-axis): enzyme activity ki raftaar (rate).
Qadam 2: scale aur range tay karein: x-axis ki kam se kam aur zyada se zyada qeemat aur waqfe; yahan 5°C, 10°C, 20°C, 30°C aur 40°C.
Qadam 3: axes ke naam likhein: x-axis 'Temperature (°C)', y-axis 'Enzyme activity (μmol/min)'.
Qadam 4: nuqte (data points) lagayein: (5°C, 2 μmol/min), (10°C, 4 μmol/min), (20°C, 7 μmol/min), (30°C, 5 μmol/min), (40°C, 3 μmol/min).
Qadam 5: formatting theek karein: tick marks barabar faasle par hon, aur nuqton ko lakeer se jor kar rujhan dikhayein.

blocks.alt: Line graph: The effect of temperature on enzyme activity. X-axis Temperature (darja C), 0 se 45 tak 5 ke qadmon mein; y-axis Enzyme activity (micromol/min), 0 se 8. Narangi nuqte (5, 2), (10, 4), (20, 7), (30, 5) aur (40, 3) halki neeli lakeer se jure hue, grid ke saath.
blocks.caption: Enzyme activity par darja hararat ke asar ka x-axis data figure (kitab ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke temperatures x-axis par barabar faasle par hain kyunke waqfe milte julte hain, lekin 5, 10, 20, 30, 40 ke darmiyan farq 5, 10, 10 aur 10 hai. Sahih scale par (jaisa graph mein) 5°C se 10°C ka faasla baqi faaslon ka aadha hai. Graph se pata chalta hai ke enzyme ki activity 20°C par sab se zyada hai.
blocks.title: Scale sahih rakhein

blocks.text: Error bars

Error bars graph par lagi chhoti lakeerein hain jo bar charts (aur doosre plots) par data ka farq (variability) ya ghair yaqeeni pan (uncertainty) dikhati hain. In se pata chalta hai ke alag alag qeematein bar ki dikhayi gayi markazi qeemat (maslan mean) se aam taur par kitni door hoti hain.
Error bars ki qismein
Bar chart par error bars banane ke do sab se aam tareeqe:
Range error bars
Range error bars har bar ke liye group ki sab se chhoti (minimum) aur sab se bari (maximum) qeemat istemal karti hain. Lakeer minimum se maximum tak jati hai aur data ka poora phailao dikhati hai.
Standard deviation (SD) error bars

SD error bars dikhati hain ke qeematein mean se ausatan kitni door hain. Bar chart par har bar aik group ka mean hota hai; SD error bars mean se aik (ya zyada) standard deviation oopar aur neeche jati hain (±SD).
Bar chart par error bars banane ke qadam (misaal)

Researchers teen alag roshniyon mein paudon ki ausat unchai (cm) naap rahe hain. Woh bean (lobia) ke paude teen groups mein ugate hain: Group A kam roshni, Group B darmiyani roshni, Group C zyada roshni. Chaar hafton baad paudon ki unchai naapi jati hai.

blocks.caption: Chaar hafte baad bean paudon ki unchai (cm)

items: Qadam 1: har group ka mean: A = (10 + 11 + 9)/3 = 10 cm, B = (14 + 16 + 15)/3 = 15 cm, C = (18 + 20 + 19)/3 = 19 cm. Bars 10, 15 aur 19 ki unchai tak bante hain.
Qadam 2: phailao nikalein. SD error bars ke liye har group ki SD ≈ 1. Range error bars ke liye: A min 9, max 11; B min 14, max 16; C min 18, max 20.

Qadam 3: error bars banayein. SD error bar: mean (bar ki chhat) se 1 cm oopar aur 1 cm neeche (mean ± 1 SD): A 9 se 11, B 14 se 16, C 18 se 20. Range error bar: har group ke minimum se maximum tak. Har sire par chhoti ufqi topi (cap) lagayein.

blocks.caption: Paudon ki naap ka statistical khulasa (kitab ka table)

blocks.alt: Safaid bars: Group A (mean 10), Group B (15), Group C (19); y-axis Mean, 0 se 25. Har bar par do topi wale error bars saath saath: surkh SD (jama/minus) error aur neela Range (jama/minus) error, dono mean se 1 oopar aur 1 neeche. Legend: SD (+/-) error surkh, Range (+/-) error neela.
blocks.caption: Mukhtalif roshni mein paudon ki ausat unchai, error bars ke saath (kitab ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Kitab ke graph mein x-axis ke neeche 'Axis Title' likha reh gaya hai (Excel ka khali naam); yeh label nahi, is liye yahan nahi likha gaya.
blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti

blocks.text: Har group ke bar par do error bars hain: surkh SD error bar aur neela range error bar. Is data mein dono 1 cm hain, is liye dono barabar lambe hain. Group C ka bar sab se ooncha hai: zyada roshni mein paude sab se zyada barhe.
blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein

blocks.text: Kitab har group ki SD taqreeban 1 batati hai. Chapter ke formula se (N = 3 se taqseem) 9, 10 aur 11 ki SD taqreeban 0.82 aati hai; chhote sample ke liye aam tareeqe se N − 1 se taqseem karne par theek 1 aati hai. Range error bars (± 1 cm) bilkul durust hain.
blocks.title: Yahan standard deviation ke baare mein

blocks.prompt: Dikhayein ke blood types ke zawiye mil kar poora daira banate hain.
Jangal ke darakhton mein har species ka feesad dikhane ke liye kaun sa chart behtar hai?
blocks.explanation: Pie chart, kyunke yeh poore (tamam darakhton) ke hisse dikhata hai.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Pie chart: sector angle = (qisam ki qeemat / total) × 360°; poora daira 360°.
X-axis data figure: x par independent, y par dependent variable; sahih scale, nuqte lakeer se jore.
Error bars: range (min se max) ya mean ± SD, siron par topi (cap).
